summary.en: Comparatives, adverbs of frequency, in/on/at for time, the first conditional, relative clauses and linking words.
summary.bs: Poređenje, prilozi učestalosti, in/on/at za vrijeme, prvi kondicional, odnosne rečenice i riječi za povezivanje.

concepts.youtubeQuery: comparative and superlative adjectives english rules

bs.one: Komparativ poredi dvije stvari (bigger than), superlativ izdvaja najveću iz grupe (the biggest).
bs.explain: Kratki pridjevi: -er / the -est (cheap → cheaper → the cheapest; big → bigger, udvaja se suglasnik; happy → happier). Dugi pridjevi: more / the most (expensive → more expensive → the most expensive). Nepravilni: good → better → the best, bad → worse → the worst, far → further → the furthest. Poslije komparativa ide 'than'.
bs.example: 'Zagreb is bigger than Mostar. Sarajevo is the biggest city in Bosnia.'
bs.why: Poređenje ti treba stalno: kupovina, posao, opis ljudi i mjesta.
bs.mixup: Ne kombinuj oba načina: 'more bigger' je pogrešno. Ili -er ili more, nikad oba.

concepts.youtubeQuery: adverbs of frequency always usually often sometimes never

bs.one: Prilozi učestalosti kažu koliko često: always (uvijek), usually (obično), often (često), sometimes (ponekad), rarely (rijetko), never (nikad).
bs.explain: Mjesto u rečenici je važno: ispred glavnog glagola (I often cook), ali iza 'be' (She is always late). Uz pomoćni glagol stoje između: 'I have never been there', 'I don't usually eat breakfast'.
bs.example: 'I always drink coffee in the morning, but I never drink it after 6.'
bs.why: Ovim pričaš o navikama, što je jedna od glavnih tema na početnim nivoima.
bs.mixup: 'I go always to work by bus' je pogrešno. Prilog ide ispred glagola: 'I always go to work by bus'.

concepts.youtubeQuery: prepositions of time in on at english

bs.one: Za vrijeme engleski koristi tri prijedloga: at za tačno vrijeme, on za dane i datume, in za duže periode.
bs.explain: AT: at 5 o'clock, at night, at the weekend (brit.). ON: on Monday, on 3 May, on my birthday. IN: in May, in 2024, in summer, in the morning. Pravilo piramide: in (široko) → on (dan) → at (tačka). Bez prijedloga: today, tomorrow, yesterday, next week, last year, every day.
bs.example: 'I start work at 8 on Mondays, but in summer I start at 7.'
bs.why: Ovo se koristi u gotovo svakom dogovoru i rasporedu.
bs.mixup: 'In the morning' ali 'on Monday morning'. Kad se doda dan, prelazi se na 'on'.

bs.one: Prvi kondicional govori o stvarnoj mogućnosti u budućnosti: If it rains, I will stay at home.
bs.explain: Formula: If + present simple, will + glagol. U dijelu s 'if' NE ide will, iako se radi o budućnosti. Dijelovi mogu zamijeniti mjesta: 'I will stay at home if it rains' (bez zareza). Postoji i nulti kondicional za opšte istine: If you heat ice, it melts (present + present).
bs.example: 'If you finish early, we'll go to the cinema.' 'If I see Ana, I'll tell her.'
bs.why: Uslovi i dogovori na poslu i u životu svi koriste ovu strukturu.
bs.mixup: 'If it will rain' je pogrešno. Poslije 'if' ide present: 'If it rains'.

concepts.youtubeQuery: relative clauses who which that english grammar

bs.one: Odnosna rečenica daje više informacija o imenici, kao bosanski 'koji/koja/koje': the man who lives next door.
bs.explain: 'Who' za ljude, 'which' za stvari i životinje, 'that' za oboje (razgovorno). 'Whose' = čiji. 'Where' = gdje. Kad je odnosna zamjenica objekat, možeš je izostaviti: 'the book (that) I read'. Kad je subjekat, ne možeš: 'the man who called'.
bs.example: 'This is the colleague who helped me.' 'The car which I bought is blue.' 'The town where I was born is small.'
bs.why: Pomoću njih spajaš dvije kratke rečenice u jednu prirodnu.
bs.mixup: Ne koristi 'what' kao 'koji': 'the film what I saw' je pogrešno; treba 'the film that/which I saw'.

concepts.youtubeQuery: linking words english however although because so

bs.one: Riječi za povezivanje (linking words) povezuju ideje i pokazuju odnos: dodavanje, suprotnost, razlog, posljedica, redoslijed.
bs.explain: Dodavanje: and, also, too. Suprotnost: but, however, although. Razlog: because, because of. Posljedica: so, that's why. Redoslijed: first, then, after that, finally. 'However' obično počinje novu rečenicu i ima zarez: 'It was cheap. However, it was bad.'
bs.example: 'First, I made coffee. Then I checked my emails. After that, I had a meeting. Finally, I went home.'
bs.why: Uz ove riječi tvoj govor i pisanje izgledaju organizovano, što je ključno za B1 nivo.
bs.mixup: 'Because' + rečenica (because it rained), 'because of' + imenica (because of the rain).

explain.bs: Nepravilan pridjev: good – better – the best.
Poslije 'if' u prvom kondicionalu ide present simple.

q.bs: 'The woman ___ lives upstairs is a nurse.'
